head.text: Jira page, rebuilt around agent sessions

q1.text: Board: A (three equal lanes) or B (agent deck on top, no-agent tickets on short shelves)? B keeps a 40+ ticket board short; A keeps one card grammar.

q2.text: List: a row is a SESSION (a ticket worked twice shows twice). Alternative: a row per ticket with its sessions folded under it.

q3.text: Detail: opens from any card or row. Left = the ticket's agent (live session + history timeline). Right = everything the current Jira modal does today (transitions, assign, children, description).

q4.text: Unverified: the 'permission' / 'plan approval' wording needs the dashboard's session list to say what a session waits on. Its type has question | stop | permission | plan; not yet checked that /api/sessions returns it.
